changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionsExternal') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionsExternal]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ExternalID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Status] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [Detail] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [Component] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionsExternal] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID]) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Api_ExecutionsExternal_component_externalid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Api_ExecutionsExternal_component_externalid] ON [api].[ExecutionsExternal] ([Component],[ExternalID]) END
